scope: Read-only source and existing-result audit; no RTL simulation or numerical change.

frozen_ppa_source.source_equivalence: Current RTL differs only in whitespace from frozen PPA source.

core_default_equivalence: fixed_point_shadow adds optional state return and software counterfactual callbacks; without callbacks its arithmetic is the same as shadow_qualification_v1.

arithmetic_audit.qkv_quantization: External software: symmetric per-tensor job-global scale; half-away-from-zero; clamp [-127,127]. RTL consumes the resulting signed INT8 bytes.
arithmetic_audit.score: QK exact signed INT8 dot fits INT32 for d<=128; score delta scaled by positive signed16 mantissa and 6-bit shift; round nearest ties away; saturate signed16 Q8.
arithmetic_audit.probability_alpha: Original eight-segment PWL table, exp(0)=32767, x<=-2048 maps0; no ideal-exp or counterfactual replacement.
arithmetic_audit.dense_bypass: bypass=old_row_state_valid & ~row_has_valid. Valid dense query rows with a nonempty actual KV tile do not bypass. It is NOT an alpha==32767 bypass.
arithmetic_audit.cross_tile: Both old O and L multiply alpha then arithmetic/logical >>>15 respectively. alpha=32767 still attenuates in valid dense tiles. First tile alpha=0.
arithmetic_audit.row_sum: Unsigned32 L saturates at 0xffffffff; software matches.
arithmetic_audit.pv: Unsigned P16 times signed V8; every PE addition wraps low32. Software modular prefix accounting reproduces final INT32 wrap and diagnoses pre-wrap overflow.
arithmetic_audit.normalizer: Original16-entry reciprocal seed with leading-one exponent restoration/truncation; O*reciprocal >>>15, original signed output multiplier/shift, nearest ties-away INT8 saturation.
arithmetic_audit.positive_multiplier_scope: Software interprets low16 as unsigned; RTL uses signed16. Equivalence is restricted to encode_multiplier-generated mantissas1..32767, as used by these manifests. It is not a generic proof for negative/high-bit mantissas.
arithmetic_audit.tail_scope: Shadow returns logical valid query/token outputs. Physical invalid lanes and empty-row bypass are not generic mask/causal coverage; current workload is dense noncausal.

error_metric_protocol.dequantization: O_model = signed_int8_output * frozen scale_o for its model/layer.
error_metric_protocol.reference: FP32 SDPA recomputed from captured Q/K/V cast to FP32; not a claim that the entire source generation model ran FP32.
error_metric_protocol.mae: mean(abs(O_model - O_reference)) over explicitly stated tensor elements.
error_metric_protocol.rmse: sqrt(mean((O_model - O_reference)^2)); aggregate by SSE/count, not mean of per-head RMSE.
error_metric_protocol.units: Original attention-output activation units; optional INT8-code errors must be separately labeled.
error_metric_protocol.stage_split: Input quantization error, fixed-point error against dequantized-QKV FP32 SDPA, and total error against captured-QKV FP32 SDPA remain separate.
error_metric_protocol.accuracy_warning: Byte-exact RTL/shadow agreement does not prove acceptable FP32 error or generation quality.

software_only_scope: Only the explicitly listed rtl_exact_jobs have audited complete RTL output equality. A new software comparison against any of124 frozen o.bin vectors does not turn that vector into an RTL-measured job. Vectors absent here must be labeled software versus frozen golden only unless their own complete RTL artifact is separately audited.
replay_build_provenance_limit: Executable SHA and original compile logs are retained. Source equivalence is grounded in frozen Git source plus formatting proof and unchanged RTL history; the old replay build has no separate per-input compilation source-hash manifest. Do not invent one.
